basics.name: Aaron Remedios
basics.label: M.S. Robotics | Robotics Engineer • Autonomous Systems • Controls
basics.summary: Robotics Engineer (M.S. Robotics, Purdue University, Fall 2027) with four years of experience designing, developing, and testing robotic and electromechanical systems. Experienced across robot hardware, controls, and software integration — from embedded electronics and PCB design to ROS2-based autonomy, sensor fusion, and real-time control. Earned a B.Tech from University of Mumbai (CGPA: 8.5). Focused on autonomous robotics, intelligent systems, and real-time control architectures.

education.area: Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering (Honors in Data Science)

work.summary: Worked on drone fleet management, autonomous rail-inspection data analysis, and ML-based predictive maintenance.
highlights: Led the evaluation, selection, and implementation of fleet management software for 104 drones, gathering requirements and coordinating deployment with stakeholders and vendors.
Analyzed ATIP autonomous rail-inspection data to identify trends and opportunities to improve track-monitoring and inspection processes.
Processed and analyzed drone photogrammetry data using CloudCompare, working with 3D point clouds to evaluate captured infrastructure.
Earned FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certification, enabling compliant commercial UAS operations and safe flight planning.
Developed ML prediction models using ATIP autonomous rail-inspection data to detect deteriorating rail assets and identify potential maintenance risks for proactive infrastructure monitoring.

Diagnosed a fleet-wide batch of manufacturing-defective concrete rail ties and built a Python/SQL pipeline to query LiDAR-derived cant and gauge measurements from CN's rail-inspection databases at scale, automatically flagging ties matching the defect signature.
Replaced a fully manual, ties-by-tie visual inspection process with this automated, data-driven detection method, enabling rapid and accurate identification of affected ties across the rail network.

work.summary: Designed embedded robotic systems for inspection/cleaning automation, including PCBs, control, and sensing.
highlights: Built a compact pipe-inspection robot using ESP32 and a custom 4-layer PCB for <50 mm diameter pipelines.
Implemented sensor fusion (EKF) and dead-reckoning for accurate localization.
Engineered electromechanical subsystems for a sewer-cleaning robot with hydraulics controlled via Raspberry Pi 5.
Developed sonar-based mapping for pipe cleaning and obstruction detection.
Designed a high-voltage AC subsystem for an autonomous solar panel placement robot.

work.position: Project Lead — Chamfering Machine for Rack Gear
work.summary: Led development of an automated chamfering system including embedded compute and HMI.
highlights: Designed and deployed a chamfering machine that reduced gear chipping by ~85%.
Used Raspberry Pi as the computational backbone; designed mechanical components in SolidWorks/AutoCAD.
Built an HMI in React.js and implemented an algorithm to compute chamfering angle from rack dimensions.

work.summary: Worked on PLC automation and industrial maintenance workflows.
highlights: Worked with PLC automation using hydraulic motors.
Hands-on exposure to Siemens PLC concepts and industrial troubleshooting.

work.summary: Designed embedded electronics and reverse-engineered controllers for EV conversion systems.
highlights: Designed an EV conversion kiosk with HMI, solenoid locking, NFC access, GPS, and backend-linked tracking.
Reverse-engineered a high-cost ESC to create an in-house controller (~40% cost reduction).
Integrated hardware into a PCB and implemented three custom PPM-based control modes.

projects.title: Autonomous Drone Infrastructure Inspection Using Vision-Language-Action Models — Ideas Lab Student Researcher
bullets: Proposed a VLA-based autonomous inspection architecture combining visual perception, semantic reasoning, and robotic planning for infrastructure monitoring applications.
Explored AI-driven next-best-view planning and adaptive exploration strategies to improve inspection coverage and reduce manual flight operations.
Investigated language-conditioned next-best-view (NBV) planning for autonomous UAV exploration, allowing the system to select informative viewpoints based on inspection objectives.

projects.title: Multi-Agent SLAM: Combining Neural Implicit and Gaussian Scene Representations
bullets: Conducted a research study comparing neural implicit maps and explicit Gaussian scene representations for scalable multi-agent SLAM systems using MNE-SLAM and MAGiC-SLAM.
Developed an evaluation pipeline using Gaussian submaps as an explicit geometric backend to analyze loop closures, global map consistency, and multi-agent map optimization.

projects.title: StarkHacks — World's Largest Hackathon — 2nd Place
bullets: Integrated robotic hardware, sensors, and embedded controllers using ROS2, validating communication between navigation, manipulation, and perception subsystems.

Integrated a LeRobot robotic arm as an autonomous desk assistant, combining Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and Vision-Language Model (VLM) pipelines to perceive and identify clutter on the desk surface.
Trained the VLA pipeline to autonomously pick and clear trash from the desk, enabling closed-loop cleanup without manual intervention.
Implemented a voice-assistant interface for the arm, enabling hands-free spoken commands to trigger desk-tidying and other on-demand tasks.

projects.title: Cosmo Logistic Theme (eYRC’23–24, IIT Bombay) — Rank 1
bullets: Engineered an autonomous warehouse logistics system integrating a robotic arm and mobile robot using ROS2, MoveIt2, and Nav2.
Implemented OpenCV-based ArUco marker detection for box localization and pose estimation.
Used Nav2 for path planning/localization and controlled a UR5 robotic arm using MoveIt for pick-and-place.

projects.title: ISRO Robotics Challenge — Team Lead
bullets: Built a six-wheel Mars-mission rover with rocker–bogie suspension and 3D-printed TPU wheels for soft sand traction.
Designed a custom ESP32-based control PCB and implemented PID control for smooth six-wheel locomotion.
Deployed OpenCV for test-tube detection and integrated LiDAR, camera, and IMU for robust navigation.
Achieved All-India Rank 9 out of 140 teams in Stage 2.

projects.title: ABU ROBOCON 2023 & 2022 — Team Manager
bullets: Designed robots for Lagori tower gameplay: passing/shooting balls, rebuilding the tower, and multi-robot coordination.
Prototyped pneumatic mechanisms using solenoid valves controlled via ESP32 microcontrollers.
Integrated LiDAR for distance measurement and developed algorithms optimizing distance-to-power ratio for tower knockdown.
Developed stair-climbing robots with STM32-based controller, custom 2-layer PCB, PID control, and sensor-feedback for distance/angle estimation and projectile/ring-shooting precision.
